slides.title: Final Pitch and the Look-Back

content_blocks.block_data: Unit 3 · SCAMPER Technique for Innovation · 120 minutes · studio · COs 109.2, 109.3, 109.4

slides.speaker_notes: Studio session. Warm-up: Read Yourself From Week One. Do not lecture past 15 minutes.

slides.title: The one idea

content_blocks.block_data: You owe the owner an answer, not a report.

slides.speaker_notes: Say it once. Do not elaborate on the slide — elaborate out loud.

slides.title: Why it matters

block_data.body: Not the business — you. Fifteen weeks ago you asked different questions.
One page, in the owner's language, saying what you saw and what you would do first.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: What to do with it

block_data.body: Not one word from this course appears in the hand-back. No SCAMPER, no BOI, no mind map.
Not five. The one you would stand behind if they did it and it failed.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: Today you will

content_blocks.block_data: Assemble your portfolio and write the one-page hand-back you will give your owner.

slides.speaker_notes: Leave this slide up for the whole making phase.

slides.title: To close

block_data.head: Pitch
block_data.body: Three minutes. The person, the stuck, the idea, the picture, the ask.

block_data.head: Critique
block_data.body: I like… / I wish… / What if… — the idea, never the person.

block_data.head: Idea log
block_data.body: One page. Silent. Box 4 is the one you read again in week 15.

slides.speaker_notes: If time runs short, cut the input — never the pitch. The pitch is how CO 109.2 is attained.
